reasoning.Experiments: The evaluation protocols (linear probing) and baselines were mostly clear and followed. They also could not run on all original datasets (STL-10), which limited direct quantitative comparisons for many results, forcing them to focus on 'relative behaviour' rather than absolute accuracies.
